title: Gluing pullback of direct images on an arbitrary open union
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U and V arbitrary opens and M any O_X-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For each open A let J_A = j_A,* (M restricted to A), with the fixed nested-open restriction maps from def-pc-kinjective-mayer-vietoris-data. The square with upper left J_(U union V), upper right J_U, lower left J_V and lower right J_(U intersection V), and all four arrows the fixed restrictions, is a pullback in O_X-module sheaves. No injectivity, covering assumption on X or complex is required.

source.place: Tag 01EB (lemma-mayer-vietoris), sheaf-axiom exactness on a two-open union; Tag 08BV (lemma-exact-sequence-j-star), displayed restriction/direct-image sequence

proof.text: Conjugate each image term by pushforward of overFunctorEquiv. At every test open T, its sections are M(A intersection T); lem-pc-open-module-image-section-restriction identifies all four arrows with ordinary restriction. The source union equals the union of the two middle intersections, and the target intersection equals their intersection.

Apply the two-open sheaf axiom to obtain a unique amalgamation of each compatible pair. Uniqueness proves naturality, additivity and linearity. These amalgamations assemble to a module-sheaf morphism and separatedness gives uniqueness, which is the pullback universal property. Equivalently apply TopCat.Sheaf.isLimitPullbackCone sectionwise and reflect limits through the fully faithful inclusion of module sheaves and the underlying abelian-presheaf functor.

proof_origin.note: Sheaf-level gluing step of the parent proof, without complexes or injectivity.

theorem schemeOpenUnionModuleImage_isPullback
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) :
    IsPullback
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (le_sup_left : U ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (le_sup_right : V ≤ U ⊔ V))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ≤ U))).app M)
      ((schemeOpenModuleImageRestriction X
        (homOfLE (inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ≤ V))).app M)
